scope: RP1 PCI/FDT resource nexus and interrupt controller candidate for the selected Pi 5 D0 firmware layout. No physical attachment or Ethernet/SD qualification.

native_arm64_module.flags: Original bsd.kmod.mk, -Werror, FDT and INTRNG option headers; no install/load.

validation.production_callbacks: Clang 18 and GCC with address/undefined-behavior sanitizers: BAR split/bounds, selected DMA layout, interrupt decoding, filter/thread ACK ordering, all seven cleanup failure points and retry, undersized BAR refusal, published PIC ownership.
validation.host_lock_check: FreeBSD-target locks are intentionally not host-target locks.

limitations: Selected BCM2712 PCIe2 host and exact RP1 DMA layout only; alternate firmware layouts refused.
Memory children use RF_ACTIVE BAR subregions; explicit map/unmap/adjust and RF_UNMAPPED memory requests refused.
Published PIC retained for boot lifetime because generic interrupt-controller deregistration is not implemented.
No physical MSI delivery, DMA, link, DHCP, packets or SD transfers demonstrated.
RP1 clocks, GPIO/pin control and Cadence Ethernet platform initialization remain to implement; legacy Pi SD qualification remains open.
